method.method_draft: Coordinate/shoelace route. From the image, take the displayed orientation with the square on BC below the triangle, the square on AB to the left, and the square on CA to the right; the hexagon vertices are traversed as D,E,F,G,H,I. From the text, set the equilateral triangle side length to 1. Choose coordinates B=(0,0), C=(1,0), A=(1/2,√3/2). Construct the outside square on BC to get I=(0,-1), H=(1,-1). Construct the outside square on AB by rotating vector AB by 90 degrees outward to get D=(-√3/2,1/2), E=(1/2-√3/2,√3/2+1/2). Construct the outside square on CA similarly to get F=(1/2+√3/2,√3/2+1/2), G=(1+√3/2,1/2). Apply the shoelace formula to polygon D-E-F-G-H-I to obtain area 3+√3.

method.method_draft: Area-decomposition route. From the image, view hexagon DEFGHI as made of the three outward unit squares, the original central equilateral triangle ABC, and the three connecting triangles AEF, BDI, CGH between adjacent squares. From the text, each square has side length 1, so the three squares contribute area 3, and triangle ABC has area √3/4. At each vertex of the equilateral triangle, the two square sides extending outward are both length 1 and form an included angle of 120 degrees because the original triangle angle is 60 degrees and the square sides are perpendicular to the adjacent triangle sides. Thus each of triangles AEF, BDI, CGH has area (1/2)(1)(1)sin120°=√3/4. The hexagon area is therefore 3+4(√3/4)=3+√3.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中等边三角形 ABC 位于中央，AB、BC、CA 三条边外侧分别作了正方形 ABDE、BCHI、CAFG。外轮廓按顺序是六边形 D-E-F-G-H-I。可以从图中看出，六边形 DEFGHI 由三个外侧正方形、中央三角形 ABC，以及连接相邻正方形外顶点的三个三角形 AEF、BDI、CGH 拼成。

推理：等边三角形 ABC 的边长为 1，所以三个正方形边长也都是 1，每个面积为 1，三个正方形总面积为 3。中央等边三角形 ABC 的面积为 (√3/4)·1^2 = √3/4。

在每个顶点处，例如 A 点，AE 和 AF 都是正方形的边，长度都为 1。因为正方形边分别垂直于 AB 和 AC，而 ∠BAC = 60°，所以 ∠EAF = 120°。因此三角形 AEF 的面积为 (1/2)(1)(1)sin120° = √3/4。同理，三角形 BDI 和 CGH 的面积也各为 √3/4。三个连接三角形总面积为 3√3/4。

所以六边形面积 = 三个正方形面积 + 中央三角形面积 + 三个连接三角形面积 = 3 + √3/4 + 3√3/4 = 3 + √3。
